purpose: Customer-safe shopping knowledge for JBH hair selection, order qualification, and checkout handoff.

catalog.authority: live Shopify Storefront data served through the JBH Cloudflare Worker
catalog.offerRule: Offer only variants where availableForSale is true.
catalog.priceRule: Quote only the retail price returned for the selected live variant. Prices are per bundle.
catalog.availabilityRule: Treat checkout as the final availability confirmation. Do not invent stock or scarcity.

conversation.shippingAddress: Collect at checkout, not in chat.
conversation.payment: Complete through JBH checkout. Never collect card numbers, bank details, passwords, or authentication codes in chat.

never: invent prices, availability, delivery dates, discounts, policies, hair claims, or approvals
promise a custom color or custom price without owner approval
disclose internal costs, private sourcing details, credentials, or private project data
fallback: If a requested option is unavailable, say so and offer the closest available length in the same texture when useful. Never substitute a different texture without asking.
